title: 第24章 魔天老祖第25章 鸿蒙至尊塔
slug: 混沌神体之鸿蒙至尊未命名95
content_zh:
“天地无极，万法归一，日月精华，宇宙星辰……”
此功法可以开辟人体内个穴位，每一个穴位都可以演化成丹田，每360个穴位可以升一级，大成之后就可以不死不灭，与天同寿。
叶辰听后，大吃一惊，若修炼此功法.体内将储存几倍几十倍几千倍的灵气
但是马上叶辰就想到了一个问题，就是这需要的灵气之多.每晋级一层需要的灵物都是难以估计的，而且需要大量的时间才能晋级，此功法听着确实是很好，但是弊端很大，几乎是无法修炼成功的，叶辰意识到，这恐怕也是老前辈估计才这么直接的就给了我的原因吧！老东西竟然如此算计
叶辰暗自思索了半天，不动声色问道
“前辈，既然此功法如此强大，不知前辈可否修炼，如果修炼，为何会被封印在此处”
“这，这是因为老祖得到这部功法已经修炼有成，如果要修炼此功法无异于重新修炼，老祖我并未修炼！”老祖无奈的解释道，心里却想着，“这小子好生聪明，心机如此之深，旁人若得到这部功法，无异会欣喜若狂，兴奋此功法的强大，此子竟然如此快冷静下来，看来此子不好相与啊！”
“小友，老祖这有一部神魂分身术，这部功法肯定可以让小友满意，此功法可以将人的神魂分裂，当然此功法必须是神识到达元神境才可以修炼，只要拥有足够的神魂灵药，便可以无限分裂神魂，当然如果找到重塑肉身的灵物，还可以以分裂的神魂重塑身体，炼出分身。”那声音此时不得不讨好与叶辰
叶辰淡淡的说道
“是吗？那你先告诉我，让我看看，可不要再糊弄与我了，小子虽然年轻，但也不是那么好糊弄的。”叶辰故意冷冷的说道，其实心里早就乐开了花
“日月贞明，风云不昧，泽吉四时，万物资生，五灵镇守，神气常坚，精华不散……”老祖一字一句逐一教给了叶辰
叶辰听后大喜，却喜怒不形于色，依旧云淡风轻的说道“老祖，你好人做到底，再送我一部身法如何！小子不再贪心了！”
事不过三，叶辰思索后也知道不可能无休止的索要。
“哈哈哈，小友快人快语，老祖老也喜欢小友的直接，不似那些满嘴仁义道德的伪君子，哈哈哈，好，老祖今日再传你一部，飞行法技，鲲鹏之翼，此功法可以让你在炼气境就拥有飞行的能力，但是此功法飞行也是需要很多的灵力，你日后慢慢体会，不过好处就是飞行速度一流，绝对的保命手段，这些小友自己慢慢体会”
“百川汇海，积聚于背，以气化翼，踏雪无痕，天地六合……”
叶辰仔细聆听，用心强记。
三部功法，叶辰已经牢牢记在神识之中
“多谢前辈！”叶辰感激道谢。
“小友，可愿助我破除此阵，这座宝塔定当相赠。”老祖急忙询问。
“既然前辈如此仗义，小子自当相助”叶辰一边拖延一边思考对此

“前辈，你实力强横，此阵破后，恐前辈对小子不利，小心谨慎，防范于未然，望前辈不要在意，实在是小子实力低微，不得不防”
“哈哈哈，小友如此坦言，老祖自然不于计较，容我想想”老祖思考了一会说道
“小友，老祖可以发下天道誓言，脱困之后绝对不会对小友不利”
叶辰思考了一下，也只好如此了，毕竟鸿蒙至尊塔是必须得到的，冒险也得试一试
“那就依前辈之言，发下天道誓言，我们开始破阵”
“哈哈哈，小友放心”此时的老祖只要能破阵别说天道誓言，只要能办到的事一定都会办到。
“吾以天道起誓，若小友，哦对了不知小友贵姓？”
“叶辰”
“吾以天道起誓，若叶辰小友，可助老祖我破除此处封印阵法，愿将此宝塔送给叶辰小友，并且绝对不会对小友不利”。老祖发完天道誓言
“好，那我们开始吧！”叶辰也不再啰嗦了
随即叶辰运转噬灵诀，开始吞噬其中一处阵基的灵力。
老祖在阵法内猛烈的攻击宝塔。
经过三个时辰的不懈努力，叶辰和老祖终于破除了阵法，宝塔脱离了阵法的约束，停在了百步之处。
“哈哈哈，哈哈哈”
“老祖终于出来了！”
只见一道灵魂体，白发苍苍，蓬头垢面，无尽的沧桑
老祖打量着叶辰“多谢叶小友相助”，老祖虽然一边道谢，却一边暗中打量着叶辰。
心中暗道“这小子竟然是万年不遇的混沌体，看来这是这天如此厚待老祖我，遇宝而不得，可是会失去运道的”
content_en:
"The heaven and earth are infinite, all laws are unified, the essence of the sun and moon, the stars of the universe..."
This technique can open up 10 acupuncture points in the human body, and each acupuncture point can evolve into a Dantian. Every 360 acupoints can be upgraded to a level. After completion, you will be immortal and live as long as heaven.
After Ye Chen heard this, he was shocked. If he practices this technique, his body will store several times, dozens, thousands of times the amount of spiritual energy.
But Ye Chen immediately thought of a problem, that is, the amount of spiritual energy required. The spiritual objects required for each level are difficult to estimate, and it takes a lot of time to advance. This technique sounds really good, but it has great disadvantages and is almost impossible to practice successfully. Ye Chen realized that this is probably the reason why the old man gave it to me so directly! The old thing actually has such a plan
Ye Chen thought secretly for a long time and asked calmly
"Senior, since this technique is so powerful, I wonder if senior can practice it. If so, why is it sealed here?"
"This, this is because the ancestor has already successfully practiced this technique. If you want to practice this technique, it is like practicing it all over again. I have not practiced it!" The ancestor explained helplessly, but he was thinking in his heart, "This kid is so smart and has such a deep scheming. If others get this technique, they will be ecstatic and excited about the power of this technique. He calmed down so quickly. It seems that he is not easy to deal with!"
"Little friend, my ancestor has a divine soul clone technique. This technique will definitely satisfy me. This technique can split a person's soul. Of course, this technique can only be practiced when the spiritual consciousness reaches the Yuanshen realm. As long as you have enough soul elixir, you can split the soul infinitely. Of course, if you find a spiritual object that can reshape the body, you can also use the split soul to reshape the body and create a clone." The voice had no choice but to please Ye Chen at this time.
Ye Chen said lightly
"Really? Then tell me first, let me see, and don't fool me anymore. Although the boy is young, he is not that easy to fool." Ye Chen said coldly on purpose, but in fact he was already happy in his heart.
"The sun and the moon are pure, the wind and clouds are clear, the four seasons are auspicious, all things are alive, the five spirits are guarding, the spirit is always strong, the essence never dissipates..." The ancestor taught Ye Chen word by word
Ye Chen was overjoyed after hearing this, but his joy and anger were not visible. He still said calmly and calmly, "Ancestor, you are a good person and will do it to the end. How about giving me another body skill! I'm not greedy anymore!"
It only takes three things. After thinking about it, Ye Chen knew that he couldn't keep asking for it endlessly.
"Hahaha, little friend, you are quick to talk. My ancestors also like my directness, unlike those hypocrites who talk about benevolence and morality. Hahaha, okay, my ancestors will teach you another flying technique today, Kunpeng Wings. This technique can give you the ability to fly in the Qi Refining Realm. However, flying with this technique also requires a lot of spiritual power. You will gradually understand it in the future. However, the advantage is that the flying speed is top-notch and it is an absolute life-saving means. These little friends will gradually realize it themselves."
"Hundreds of rivers merge into the sea, gathering on the back, turning the air into wings, leaving no trace on the snow, and the heaven and earth are in harmony..."
Ye Chen listened carefully and memorized it carefully.
Ye Chen has firmly memorized the three skills in his consciousness.
"Thank you, senior!" Ye Chen thanked him gratefully.
"Little friend, if you are willing to help me break this formation, I will definitely give you this pagoda." The ancestor asked hurriedly.
"Since seniors are so generous, I should help myself." Ye Chen was procrastinating while thinking about this.
"Senior, you are powerful. After this formation is broken, I am afraid that senior will be disadvantageous to the boy. Be careful and take precautions. I hope senior doesn't care. The boy is really weak and has to be on guard."
"Hahaha, my little friend said it so frankly, so of course the ancestor doesn't care about it. Let me think about it." The ancestor thought for a while and said
"My little friend, my ancestor can make an oath of heaven, and he will never do anything bad to my little friend after he escapes from trouble."
Ye Chen thought for a moment and had no choice but to do this. After all, Hongmeng Supreme Tower must be obtained.Yes, you have to give it a try if you take the risk
"Then we will follow the words of our seniors and swear an oath of heaven, and we will begin to break the formation."
"Hahaha, don't worry, little friend." At this time, as long as the ancestor can break the formation, let alone the oath of heaven, he will definitely do whatever he can.
"I swear by the law of heaven, little friend, oh by the way, I wonder what your last name is?"
"Ye Chen"
"I swear by the law of heaven, if little friend Ye Chen can help my ancestor break the sealing formation here, I am willing to give this pagoda to little friend Ye Chen, and it will never be detrimental to me." The ancestor finished swearing the oath of heaven
"Okay, let's get started!" Ye Chen stopped talking.
Then Ye Chen used the Spirit Devouring Technique and began to devour the spiritual power of one of the formation bases.
The ancestor violently attacked the pagoda within the formation.
After three hours of unremitting efforts, Ye Chen and Ancestor finally broke through the formation. The pagoda broke away from the constraints of the formation and stopped at a hundred steps.
"Hahaha, hahaha"
"The ancestor finally came out!"
I saw only a soul body, white hair, unkempt face, endless vicissitudes of life
The ancestor looked at Ye Chen and said, "Thank you, little friend Ye, for your help." Although the ancestor thanked him, he secretly looked at Ye Chen.
He thought secretly in his heart, "This kid is actually a chaotic body that has never been seen in ten thousand years. It seems that this is why the ancestors are being treated so favorably today. If I don't get the treasure, I will lose my luck."
